diff --git a/chronos/verification/rule_store.py b/chronos/verification/rule_store.py
index fb6d343..2e75db2 100644
--- a/chronos/verification/rule_store.py
+++ b/chronos/verification/rule_store.py
@@ -63,3 +63,42 @@ def list_rules(con: sqlite3.Connection, status: str | None = None) -> list[dict[
 
 def get_active_blocking_rules(con: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
     return list_rules(con, status=BLOCKING)
+
+def export_rules_json_schema(con: sqlite3.Connection, status: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Export active or specified security rules as a JSON Schema document."""
+    rules = list_rules(con, status=status)
+    return {
+        "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
+        "title": "SecurityRules",
+        "type": "object",
+        "properties": {
+            "rules": {
+                "type": "array",
+                "items": {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "rule_id": {"type": "string"},
+                        "language": {"type": "string"},
+                        "rule_text": {"type": "string"},
+                        "yaml_pattern": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                        "status": {"type": "string"},
+                        "detectability_passed": {"type": "boolean"},
+                        "created_at": {"type": "string"},
+                        "promoted_at": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                        "promoted_by": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                    },
+                    "required": ["rule_id", "language", "rule_text", "status"],
+                },
+            }
+        },
+        "definitions": {
+            rule["rule_id"]: {
+                "title": rule["rule_id"],
+                "description": rule.get("rule_text", ""),
+                "language": rule.get("language"),
+                "status": rule.get("status"),
+                "pattern": rule.get("yaml_pattern"),
+            }
+            for rule in rules
+        },
+    }
